status: completed relevance and independent occurrence-evidence review

review.requirement_proposition: Provide and apply mechanisms, with assigned and understood responsibilities, to supersede, disengage or deactivate AI systems whose performance or outcomes are inconsistent with intended use.
review.reason_for_change: DPD acknowledged the post-update error and disabled the affected AI component. The operator applied disengagement to the component producing inappropriate support responses.

conclusion_change.previous: After an update, the customer-support chatbot produced profanity and criticism of the company instead of remaining within its service role. DPD acknowledged an error and disabled the affected AI component, containing the behaviour without establishing why the update changed the responses. Inappropriate responses and disablement remain established without a forced verification-continuity or nonactivation mapping. Prior assurance reuse and an applicable available safeguard/trigger are not established.
conclusion_change.new: The post-update chatbot responses and DPD’s disablement are documented. The task-specific disengagement aligns with the contemporary mechanism requirement. The exact update mechanism and prior assurance state are not established; later framework versions are not applied retrospectively.
